grammar_proposals.description: Use the already taught ðā with the taught nominative plural nouns of all three genders.
Form the taught strong masculine nominative plurals in -as, including the selected æ/a alternations and syncopated stems.
Form the taught strong feminine nominative plurals in -a, with doubled ss in -nessa; acknowledge licensed -e alternatives.
Produce the taught unchanged neuter nominative plurals gēar, dēor, sǣd; number is not always marked by a distinct noun ending.
Produce trēowu, tācnu, ǣfenu, nīetenu from their explicitly taught stems; do not infer that every neuter adds -u.
Produce individually taught niht, męnn and sǣs without extending one pattern to every noun of the same gender.
Recognize ðā fuglas as the masculine nominative plural subject in the supported birds clause.
